pr_title: fix: don't show `state_referenced_locally` warning on types
pr_body:
## Svelte 5 rewrite

Closes #13173

I had to add a ts-ignore because the types for the types declaration are not in the `path` types and i don't think they are worth adding.

Please note that [the Svelte codebase is currently being rewritten for Svelte 5](https://svelte.dev/blog/runes). Changes should target Svelte 5, which lives on the default branch (`main`).

If your PR concerns Svelte 4 (including updates to [svelte.dev.docs](https://svelte.dev/docs)), please ensure the base branch is `svelte-4` and not `main`.

### Before submitting the PR, please make sure you do the following

- [x] It's really useful if your PR references an issue where it is discussed ahead of time. In many cases, features are absent for a reason. For large changes, please create an RFC: https://github.com/sveltejs/rfcs
- [x] Prefix your PR title with `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, or `docs:`.
- [x] This message body should clearly illustrate what problems it solves.
- [x] Ideally, include a test that fails without this PR but passes with it.

### Tests and linting

- [x] Run the tests with `pnpm test` and lint the project with `pnpm lint`

issue_context.title: `state_referenced_locally` warning appears on type guard
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The `state_referenced_locally` incorrectly appears on a type guard. Could be something to do with it having the same variable name.

![state_referenced_locally warning appearing on an object type](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/52daa352-d0f1-4c13-b790-b80021f5fcfe)


### Reproduction

https://github.com/eltigerchino/svelte-5-warning-bug-on-type

Open the src/routes/+page.svelte file with the LSP extension on.

_No response_

I think it handle this just fine but if you prefer...also wouldn't returning null be the same as replacing `typeAnnotation` on the parent? `zimmerframe` should replace everything that you return right?
